construction.formula_role: Both missing boundary values are selected from the old product square before either new boundary is inserted.

problem.question: Whether all successive first-row gaps admit a uniform bound.

published_seed.validation_scope: The published prefix is consumed as an identified premise. Its first 60 construction steps and product square are not regenerated.

accepted_basis.scope: Only the complete prime/least-factor basis is consumed. The interspersion row, modular rules and interval sieve are not rerun.

execution.scope: One new continuation over indices 61..256; timing is a single connected V8 observation.

premises.validation_scope: structural; mathematical seed and prime basis are accepted premises

execution_boundary.unexercised_branches: Other seeds, the trial-prime fallback, alternate caps and exceptional inputs have source inspection only.
